label: Majority
type: the durability level requiring the mutation to be replicated to memory on a majority of replica nodes before acknowledgement.
note: Promoted with durability:level-persist-to-majority. Both clear the bar on their own; the remaining level (persistToMajority's memory/persistence hybrid sibling) did not recur and is left unpromoted - so unlike the ejection enum this set is knowingly incomplete, and that is recorded here so a consumer does not read the two members as the whole enum.
